_comment: Standalone weekly IcM incident-activity summary (no iris). Auth is plain `az`. Rows are grouped into a Category column computed entirely by categoryKql below (a KQL case() — first matching branch wins). Edit categoryKql to reclassify; each branch is on its own line with a comment so it is easy to change. Counts are fixed (New/Resolved/Mitigated + a Transferred-Out total).
_categoryKqlNote: categoryKql is an array of lines joined with newlines into a KQL `case()` (first match wins). Each classification line is followed by its own `// ...` KQL comment so it is easy to read and edit. Keep the final 'Other' as the last-resort fallback.
categoryKql: OwningTeamId == 67250 and isnotempty(MonitorId), 'Monitor',   // Geneva-monitor incidents on the Region Access & Quota team (67250); mirrors the IcM 'monitor' shared query
TeamLeaf == 'ServiceBlueprint', 'Planned Quota',              // Planned Quota: ServiceBlueprint team
TeamLeaf == 'plannedQuotas', 'Planned Quota',                 // Planned Quota: plannedQuotas team
cf_45269 == 'PlannedQuota', 'Planned Quota',                  // Planned Quota: CIS RP incident whose RP name (cf 45269) is PlannedQuota
isnotempty(cf_45269), cf_45269,                               // RP name: CIS RP incident tagged with an RP name -> use it (Subscription, PreApprovedQuota, ...)
TeamLeaf == 'BET', 'Billing Meter',                           // Billing Meter: BET team
TeamLeaf == 'SubscriptionWhitelisting', 'CIS RPs',            // CIS RP incidents with no RP name (mostly on-demand provision jobs)
TeamLeaf == 'OnDemandQuota', 'On Demand Quota',               // On Demand Quota team
'Other')                                                      // last resort: Triage and any other/unknown team
_howToClassify: All grouping lives in categoryKql — a KQL '| extend Category = case(...)' snippet, first matching branch wins, each branch on its own commented line. Structure: first the semantic buckets (Monitor, Planned Quota, RP name, Billing Meter), then a branch per remaining team mapping its leaf to the team display name, then 'Other' only as a true last resort for unknown teams. Team display names are hard-coded here (SubscriptionWhitelisting->CIS RPs, Whitelist&Quota->Region Access & Quota, CIS-Ev2Bridge->CIS-Ev2 Bridge, OnDemandQuota->On Demand Quota, ...); refresh from IcM's team record if a team is renamed (iris icm.teamsById, or GetOnCallScheduleForTeams TeamName). Available inputs per incident: TeamLeaf (OwningTeamName after the last backslash), OwningTeamId (numeric), MonitorId (non-empty = raised by a Geneva monitor), OwningTeamName, Severity, Status, IncidentType, IsNew/IsResolved/IsMitigated/IsTransferred, and cf_<id> for each id in customFieldIds (here cf_45269 = RP name). To reclassify: add/reorder branches.
_cfVocab: cf 45269 (RP name): Subscription, PlannedQuota, PreApprovedQuota. (Other cfs seen but not used here: 45266 Blueprint/Execution Plan/Fulfillment; 45272 OnDemandQuota Ev2 extension.)
_auth: Run `az login` as a user with IcM Kusto warehouse read access. The warehouse (icmcluster.kusto.windows.net) accepts the signed-in user's token; no cert, no iris.
